This would have been a burdensome task for MZ Wallace’s streamlined international e-commerce team, but Flow’s centralized console made this e... Exclusive Shipping Flow’s console also updated the international shipping process, resulting in considerable cost savings for MZ Wallace. Flow was able to switch over and transform the shipping strategy without any effort on MZ Wallace’s part. Shoppers are now presented with clear, localized shipping options and accurate delivery times, communicated pre-purchase, ensuring that customer expectations are met.
